Builder execution opens the OCR and input review dialog before dispatch.
Saved workflows reuse unchanged tool contracts with fresh inputs and approval for every effect; unrelated catalog changes do not require republication.
An old proposal no longer prevents a current published draft from running.
Generic digest-pinned MCP mutation tools, including delete and cancel, use exact human approval and acknowledged-return evidence.
